c5-boss-bestiary.title: Your bad habits are bosses.
c5-boss-bestiary.body:
Meet the 4 monsters stealing your days.
Which one is yours?

c5-boss-bestiary.title: The Snooze Golem
c5-boss-bestiary.body:
Hits “snooze” for you and turns your mornings to stone.
Weakness: feet on the floor before the 2nd alarm.

c5-boss-bestiary.title: The Doomscroll Kraken
c5-boss-bestiary.body:
Glues your thumb to the screen and swallows your evenings.
Weakness: phone charging outside the bedroom.

c5-boss-bestiary.title: The Couch Troll
c5-boss-bestiary.body:
“Just one episode”… then four.
Weakness: 10 push-ups before the remote.

c5-boss-bestiary.title: The Junk Food Goblin
c5-boss-bestiary.body:
Hides snacks in your cupboards and burgers in your cart.
Weakness: a glass of water and a fruit first.

c5-boss-bestiary.title: Every quest = one hit.
c5-boss-bestiary.body:
In HabitQuest, a new boss shows up every Monday.
Complete your habits all week to defeat it.

c5-boss-bestiary.title: Which boss is yours?
c5-boss-bestiary.body:
Comment its name.
Save this for your next battle 📌

c6-training-arcs.title: 3 anime training arcs to steal
c6-training-arcs.body: Real habits hidden in your favorite shows.

c6-training-arcs.title:
Saitama
One Punch Man
c6-training-arcs.body:
100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats, 10 km. Every day.
Steal it: pick one tiny daily number. Start with 10.

c6-training-arcs.title:
Rock Lee
Naruto
c6-training-arcs.body:
No talent for ninjutsu, so he outworked everyone.
Steal it: on bad days, do the mini version. Never zero.

c6-training-arcs.title:
Tanjiro
Demon Slayer
c6-training-arcs.body:
Two years of training before he could cut one boulder.
Steal it: track the streak, not the result.

c6-training-arcs.title: Make your arc a game.
c6-training-arcs.body: HabitQuest turns each habit into a quest: XP, streaks, levels, and a boss to beat every week.

c6-training-arcs.title: Your arc starts today.
c6-training-arcs.body:
